task_identity_policy: Every task has exactly one stable task_id. The task_id is the only canonical identity used across AKATH, AX runtime, execution, evidence, verification, dashboards and chats.
task_record_policy: Each task is one canonical record containing its operational details. Runtime ledgers, evidence, verification and dashboards may attach records to the same task_id but may not create a competing task record or task identity.
task_type_policy: Every task is exactly one of SYSTEM or MISSION. SYSTEM tasks are enduring AKATH components managed by AX that must operate and maintain their verified baseline 24/7. MISSION tasks are finite objectives that complete when their target is achieved and verified, then close while retaining outcome experience in A MASTER BRAIN.
category_policy: Categories only organize canonical tasks for management. Categories are not a second registry and cannot create tasks.
task_count_policy: Task count is derived only from the tasks array in this registry at read time. Never pad, infer, backfill, merge, or source extra tasks from chat, dashboards, runtime ledgers, execution registries or model memory to reach a requested count.
current_work_policy: Exactly one current_work record may be active. It must reference an existing task_id in this registry. current_work is a pointer, not a second task record.
